hooks.command: if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] && ! command -v godot >/dev/null 2>&1; then nohup sh "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/setup_godot.sh" > /tmp/setup_godot.log 2>&1 & echo 'Godot 4.4.1 is being installed in the background (log: /tmp/setup_godot.log); wait for `godot --version` before using it.'; fi
